name: indaga
description: Review your own Indaga record, recovery evidence and dated lab results.

interface.longDescription: Three read-only workflows for adults reviewing their own Indaga record: record inventory, recovery evidence and selected dated lab results. Weekly comparisons are a separately installed Indaga Weekly plugin. Preserve dates, units, missing inputs and uncertainty. For consumer wellness information, not diagnosis or treatment. An Indaga account and Connect access are required. The public workflow endpoint still exposes all six read tools, including weekly.delta. Its OAuth Connect credential retains the usual broader grant, including writes through other Indaga MCP surfaces; splitting instructions does not narrow that grant. Connecting lets your chosen AI provider receive the information it reads under that provider's terms and privacy policy. Review the OAuth permissions and health-data transfer disclosure before connecting.
defaultPrompt: What does Indaga know about me?
Review my recovery evidence and today's recorded training limit.

publication.release_notes: Three contained read-only workflows and the hosted connection. Weekly is a separate instruction-only plugin.
